How to get here

Open in Google Maps

By bus

From Piura, take a bus to Los Órganos (168 km). From there, take a mototaxi to Puerto Antiguo.

By plane

Fly to Capitán FAP Víctor Montes Arias International Airport in Talara and continue by road to Los Órganos (about 67 km).

By car

From Piura, take the Panamericana Norte highway toward Talara–Máncora. At Los Órganos, follow the signs to Puerto Antiguo.

From the bus terminal

We are about 1 km from the bus terminal. A mototaxi gets you to Puerto Antiguo in about 10 minutes.

Frequently asked questions

What can I do during my stay?

Surfing, boat trips, fishing, snorkeling, kayaking, beach walks and beautiful sunsets. You can also arrange excursions and water activities during your visit.

When can I see whales?

Humpback whale watching mainly takes place from July to October, when they reach the coast of northern Peru.

Can I surf in Los Órganos?

Yes. There are well-known surf spots and local schools offering lessons for different levels.

Can I book tours during my stay?

Yes. Ask us about available activities and local operators, and we will help you find options.

Can I visit El Ñuro from Los Órganos?

Yes. El Ñuro is just a few kilometers away and is well known for its sea turtles. You can visit its pier and take boat trips.

What should I bring?

Light clothing, sunscreen, a hat or cap, sunglasses, a swimsuit and a towel. For water activities, bring a change of clothes.
